name: 2spk_short
description: Short two-speaker Q&A; sanity-checks WER + 2-way diarization.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks for making time today. How has your week been?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Busy, but mostly good. I finally finished the project I was dreading.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's a relief. Did anything about it surprise you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Honestly, how much easier it got once I stopped putting it off.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's a really useful thing to notice. Let's come back to that.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure. I think the anticipation was worse than the work itself.
